_context.team.description: The AI coworkers of the workspace work for every person invited to it.
_context.engine.greetingNamed: {name} is the first name of the person. Said by the Chief of Staff, the AI assistant of the workspace, when it wakes up at the end of the onboarding.
_context.engine.milestones: Each line names a step that really happened while the workspace's machine is set up.
_context.view.title: Title of the onboarding step that asks how the person wants to see their workspace: as the isometric board (Boxes and coworkers drawn in 3D) or as the classic view (a list of coworkers beside the chat). 'Your team' means their AI coworkers.
_context.view.hint: Line under the two tiles of the step, followed by a picture of the small switch that changes the view later, found in the menu of the workspace.
_context.showcase: The panel beside the sign-in form: four chapters, each a short tab label, a headline, one line, and the text of an example drawn in the real interface (a job typed by a user, a coworker's answer, a small table).
_context.showcase.create.job: Typed by a user in the box that creates a coworker. {when} is showcase.create.when and has to read naturally in the middle of the sentence.
_context.showcase.task.title: 'Them' are the AI coworkers.
_context.showcase.done.routine: Name of a routine that runs every morning on the user's emails.
_context.trust.users: {count} is already formatted, such as 4,500. The sentence of the landing page's hero.
_context.sectors: Lines of work offered on the question 'Tell us what you do'. `label` is drawn on a small tile: two or three words. `keywords` are never shown: the other words people of this language type to look for that line of work, separated by spaces. Do not translate them word for word, write the words people really use, jobs included.
_context.promises: What an AI coworker does for the person, in their voice ('my') or as a short imperative, on one line.
_context.sector.use: Tile that keeps what the person typed as their answer. {words} is what they typed.
_context.sector.panel.heading: Title bar of a small window that lists the first AI coworkers offered for the line of work picked.
_context.sector.panel.anyone: Shown in that title bar while no line of work is picked.
